Only time cures a hangover, so pacing your intake and drinking water are the most reliable ways to limit symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF17Aih9Ka3T4xeMlxhqDgRrtCBT-Woi2rqIU7fAk8catHUkBabmN-2ka5LKBP6yv3-g7T2Gq9vw25BN2nj8FCkbhInfgJDoTkTPCUrkwOqDFmIuPCoEzyWU1EBCsrL1ASCM10mfLIdMX11RvcrUO7q9j2xvGdQyAa8mzwVAPWI2xa)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF18wc-ZZZrLQXH4yr34lZTa9Q9JHVgLgDemCrNrmxsihjg3NGceCEfLifA6yKy0jBDPanCu3FtyJnRW0KMQCASmURSVKBNxr2MNL1toj4lPNjQtCqFPJGLheOR5UicKNLMq7oWztlK40scigKgK1lNbj7roxKVITQD_CXJRvroMVosw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXLcU6Fz14pERB3Gfe7ZTyRLYRK8e5sGeOn4yYD4PhBoJLDe_-nfleDlFOu8ktp2wm9zAh-e103AiYTnHEEZOQcgbt9Na3_-z1a3g2sELwZj4e9SWsHTVC8fp-mmFwRXTXHQ9Zi3uYecbXdz9eT7b_AKq76g)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESXQHEIkXX2Rkggjx3YlO6qwKrsg8SkLFGH_0vPgi8TRhtN1RiiYpm3O3nlPBq39HkhlOEnaDsKDaaXjvBWOQNSLPPy1X9_zjwDai3a4GJVr5_uowskbNxO_HhKoan1g)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXkJkAs5_Eb7maOW6wW4_eldGOA-yixIxfHR0pOwp4NXE6xpIeMOURAtndMr2XAKz-42Qn72Vt419TN7b__By4GGHtbxRfDhH2I4FRfqy6KUIs_KfvQSr1XiD_Gw6yaYGwxllwzzdvBREzuRqtb-H1sZ68q4dHpyfyOw)

### Why Mead Hangovers Happen

- **Alcohol volume & ABV:** Mead ranges from around 3.5% to over 20% ABV. Most users on [Homebrew Talk](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXQBWl2hIi04wvBnvwIngWogb2bq2YIzaw3urIef13rLP1WoxntzD58vwB3WlguHl2hjunRRizfer75uZ-GpS1zITaIqT4YDLfzAet3tksCelvZXwA2axW73yKhmaKccJnrcUZzYdw3AaJ2AU) agree that people often drink mead like beer despite wine-like alcohol levels, leading to faster, heavier intoxication.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESXQHEIkXX2Rkggjx3YlO6qwKrsg8SkLFGH_0vPgi8TRhtN1RiiYpm3O3nlPBq39HkhlOEnaDsKDaaXjvBWOQNSLPPy1X9_zjwDai3a4GJVr5_uowskbNxO_HhKoan1g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXQBWl2hIi04wvBnvwIngWogb2bq2YIzaw3urIef13rLP1WoxntzD58vwB3WlguHl2hjunRRizfer75uZ-GpS1zITaIqT4YDLfzAet3tksCelvZXwA2axW73yKhmaKccJnrcUZzYdw3AaJ2AU)
- **Sugar content:** Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF18wc-ZZZrLQXH4yr34lZTa9Q9JHVgLgDemCrNrmxsihjg3NGceCEfLifA6yKy0jBDPanCu3FtyJnRW0KMQCASmURSVKBNxr2MNL1toj4lPNjQtCqFPJGLheOR5UicKNLMq7oWztlK40scigKgK1lNbj7roxKVITQD_CXJRvroMVosw) agree that sweet meads can contribute to worse hangovers due to added sugar.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF18wc-ZZZrLQXH4yr34lZTa9Q9JHVgLgDemCrNrmxsihjg3NGceCEfLifA6yKy0jBDPanCu3FtyJnRW0KMQCASmURSVKBNxr2MNL1toj4lPNjQtCqFPJGLheOR5UicKNLMq7oWztlK40scigKgK1lNbj7roxKVITQD_CXJRvroMVosw)
- **Fermentation byproducts:** Homebrewers note that stressed yeast (from fast fermentation, high heat, or low nutrients) can raise higher/fusel alcohols, which some associate with rougher hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXkJkAs5_Eb7maOW6wW4_eldGOA-yixIxfHR0pOwp4NXE6xpIeMOURAtndMr2XAKz-42Qn72Vt419TN7b__By4GGHtbxRfDhH2I4FRfqy6KUIs_KfvQSr1XiD_Gw6yaYGwxllwzzdvBREzuRqtb-H1sZ68q4dHpyfyOw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXLcU6Fz14pERB3Gfe7ZTyRLYRK8e5sGeOn4yYD4PhBoJLDe_-nfleDlFOu8ktp2wm9zAh-e103AiYTnHEEZOQcgbt9Na3_-z1a3g2sELwZj4e9SWsHTVC8fp-mmFwRXTXHQ9Zi3uYecbXdz9eT7b_AKq76g)
- **Core alcohol effects:** According to the [National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF17Aih9Ka3T4xeMlxhqDgRrtCBT-Woi2rqIU7fAk8catHUkBabmN-2ka5LKBP6yv3-g7T2Gq9vw25BN2nj8FCkbhInfgJDoTkTPCUrkwOqDFmIuPCoEzyWU1EBCsrL1ASCM10mfLIdMX11RvcrUO7q9j2xvGdQyAa8mzwVAPWI2xa) , hangovers stem from mild dehydration, fragmented sleep, gastrointestinal irritation, and inflammation, with total alcohol intake driving severity.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF17Aih9Ka3T4xeMlxhqDgRrtCBT-Woi2rqIU7fAk8catHUkBabmN-2ka5LKBP6yv3-g7T2Gq9vw25BN2nj8FCkbhInfgJDoTkTPCUrkwOqDFmIuPCoEzyWU1EBCsrL1ASCM10mfLIdMX11RvcrUO7q9j2xvGdQyAa8mzwVAPWI2xa)

### Prevention & Relief Tips

- **Drink less and pace yourself:** Limiting how much alcohol you consume is the only way to prevent a hangover. Alternate mead with water.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF17Aih9Ka3T4xeMlxhqDgRrtCBT-Woi2rqIU7fAk8catHUkBabmN-2ka5LKBP6yv3-g7T2Gq9vw25BN2nj8FCkbhInfgJDoTkTPCUrkwOqDFmIuPCoEzyWU1EBCsrL1ASCM10mfLIdMX11RvcrUO7q9j2xvGdQyAa8mzwVAPWI2xa)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXkJkAs5_Eb7maOW6wW4_eldGOA-yixIxfHR0pOwp4NXE6xpIeMOURAtndMr2XAKz-42Qn72Vt419TN7b__By4GGHtbxRfDhH2I4FRfqy6KUIs_KfvQSr1XiD_Gw6yaYGwxllwzzdvBREzuRqtb-H1sZ68q4dHpyfyOw)
- **Choose drier or lower-ABV styles:** Dry or lower-ABV meads reduce sugar and total alcohol load compared to sweet, strong pours.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF17Aih9Ka3T4xeMlxhqDgRrtCBT-Woi2rqIU7fAk8catHUkBabmN-2ka5LKBP6yv3-g7T2Gq9vw25BN2nj8FCkbhInfgJDoTkTPCUrkwOqDFmIuPCoEzyWU1EBCsrL1ASCM10mfLIdMX11RvcrUO7q9j2xvGdQyAa8mzwVAPWI2xa)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF18wc-ZZZrLQXH4yr34lZTa9Q9JHVgLgDemCrNrmxsihjg3NGceCEfLifA6yKy0jBDPanCu3FtyJnRW0KMQCASmURSVKBNxr2MNL1toj4lPNjQtCqFPJGLheOR5UicKNLMq7oWztlK40scigKgK1lNbj7roxKVITQD_CXJRvroMVosw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESXQHEIkXX2Rkggjx3YlO6qwKrsg8SkLFGH_0vPgi8TRhtN1RiiYpm3O3nlPBq39HkhlOEnaDsKDaaXjvBWOQNSLPPy1X9_zjwDai3a4GJVr5_uowskbNxO_HhKoan1g)
- **Hydrate and rest:** Drink water or fluids to ease thirst and fluid loss, and give your body time to recover.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF17Aih9Ka3T4xeMlxhqDgRrtCBT-Woi2rqIU7fAk8catHUkBabmN-2ka5LKBP6yv3-g7T2Gq9vw25BN2nj8FCkbhInfgJDoTkTPCUrkwOqDFmIuPCoEzyWU1EBCsrL1ASCM10mfLIdMX11RvcrUO7q9j2xvGdQyAa8mzwVAPWI2xa)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXkJkAs5_Eb7maOW6wW4_eldGOA-yixIxfHR0pOwp4NXE6xpIeMOURAtndMr2XAKz-42Qn72Vt419TN7b__By4GGHtbxRfDhH2I4FRfqy6KUIs_KfvQSr1XiD_Gw6yaYGwxllwzzdvBREzuRqtb-H1sZ68q4dHpyfyOw)
- **Use caution with pain relievers:** The National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism warns that combining alcohol with acetaminophen can harm the liver, while NSAIDs like aspirin and ibuprofen can further irritate the stomach. (Most users on a [Facebook](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXkJkAs5_Eb7maOW6wW4_eldGOA-yixIxfHR0pOwp4NXE6xpIeMOURAtndMr2XAKz-42Qn72Vt419TN7b__By4GGHtbxRfDhH2I4FRfqy6KUIs_KfvQSr1XiD_Gw6yaYGwxllwzzdvBREzuRqtb-H1sZ68q4dHpyfyOw) group also agree on hydrating with water or electrolytes and keeping fermentation clean, though clinical evidence for hangover remedies remains limited.)[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXlleAhD5p9ufegLnBEv6j8Aux9Urg_Q2T9ezgFUqepVKPwbpWGzODiMsy2A2TMEgDCqrFpBfPyB8iIOhBTXpspxF0aC5HwRqxrZpkb0z576HCT8-2x-w_Q_Q3z24WQQLqDokWmQSOXQMzQVqtroj59ZarMEBG8Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF17Aih9Ka3T4xeMlxhqDgRrtCBT-Woi2rqIU7fAk8catHUkBabmN-2ka5LKBP6yv3-g7T2Gq9vw25BN2nj8FCkbhInfgJDoTkTPCUrkwOqDFmIuPCoEzyWU1EBCsrL1ASCM10mfLIdMX11RvcrUO7q9j2xvGdQyAa8mzwVAPWI2xa)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXkJkAs5_Eb7maOW6wW4_eldGOA-yixIxfHR0pOwp4NXE6xpIeMOURAtndMr2XAKz-42Qn72Vt419TN7b__By4GGHtbxRfDhH2I4FRfqy6KUIs_KfvQSr1XiD_Gw6yaYGwxllwzzdvBREzuRqtb-H1sZ68q4dHpyfyOw)

- **Hydrate and rest:** Drink water or fluids to ease thirst and fluid loss, and give your body time to recover.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF17Aih9Ka3T4xeMlxhqDgRrtCBT-Woi2rqIU7fAk8catHUkBabmN-2ka5LKBP6yv3-g7T2Gq9vw25BN2nj8FCkbhInfgJDoTkTPCUrkwOqDFmIuPCoEzyWU1EBCsrL1ASCM10mfLIdMX11RvcrUO7q9j2xvGdQyAa8mzwVAPWI2xa)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXkJkAs5_Eb7maOW6wW4_eldGOA-yixIxfHR0pOwp4NXE6xpIeMOURAtndMr2XAKz-42Qn72Vt419TN7b__By4GGHtbxRfDhH2I4FRfqy6KUIs_KfvQSr1XiD_Gw6yaYGwxllwzzdvBREzuRqtb-H1sZ68q4dHpyfyOw)
- **Use caution with pain relievers:** The National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism warns that combining alcohol with acetaminophen can harm the liver, while NSAIDs like aspirin and ibuprofen can further irritate the stomach. (Most users on a [Facebook](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXkJkAs5_Eb7maOW6wW4_eldGOA-yixIxfHR0pOwp4NXE6xpIeMOURAtndMr2XAKz-42Qn72Vt419TN7b__By4GGHtbxRfDhH2I4FRfqy6KUIs_KfvQSr1XiD_Gw6yaYGwxllwzzdvBREzuRqtb-H1sZ68q4dHpyfyOw) group also agree on hydrating with water or electrolytes and keeping fermentation clean, though clinical evidence for hangover remedies remains limited.)[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXlleAhD5p9ufegLnBEv6j8Aux9Urg_Q2T9ezgFUqepVKPwbpWGzODiMsy2A2TMEgDCqrFpBfPyB8iIOhBTXpspxF0aC5HwRqxrZpkb0z576HCT8-2x-w_Q_Q3z24WQQLqDokWmQSOXQMzQVqtroj59ZarMEBG8Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF17Aih9Ka3T4xeMlxhqDgRrtCBT-Woi2rqIU7fAk8catHUkBabmN-2ka5LKBP6yv3-g7T2Gq9vw25BN2nj8FCkbhInfgJDoTkTPCUrkwOqDFmIuPCoEzyWU1EBCsrL1ASCM10mfLIdMX11RvcrUO7q9j2xvGdQyAa8mzwVAPWI2xa)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXkJkAs5_Eb7maOW6wW4_eldGOA-yixIxfHR0pOwp4NXE6xpIeMOURAtndMr2XAKz-42Qn72Vt419TN7b__By4GGHtbxRfDhH2I4FRfqy6KUIs_KfvQSr1XiD_Gw6yaYGwxllwzzdvBREzuRqtb-H1sZ68q4dHpyfyOw)
